top2017.csv.note: no missing values in the 3 features

top50_2020.csv.note: extra unnamed index col + artist/album/track_name/track_id/genre; no missing values

books.csv.note: 4 rows contain unquoted commas (line 3350 etc.) -> 13 fields; recovered by merging middle fields into 'authors'; 0 missing average_rating, no duplicate bookID

vgsales.csv.note: 58 missing Publisher (0.17% of global sales), 271 missing Year; Global_Sales ~= sum of regional sales (max diff 0.02)

The Movies Dataset/movies_metadata.csv.note: 6 missing vote_average, 2998 rows with vote_average==0 (mostly vote_count==0), 30 duplicate ids; read with usecols + low_memory=False (popularity/id columns are dirty strings)

sampling_notes: All files are small enough to read in full except movies_metadata.csv (33MB) which should be read with usecols.

music_features.definition: per-year mean (arithmetic) and standard deviation (sample, ddof=1 = pandas default) of danceability/energy/valence over all tracks in that year's file (n=100/100/50).

anova.test: scipy.stats.f_oneway (one-way ANOVA, 3 groups: 2017/2018/2020), no missing values so no listwise deletion needed
anova.interpretation: no feature differs significantly at alpha=0.05 (danceability p=0.489, energy p=0.089, valence p=0.147); energy is closest to significance

game_market_hhi.definition: HHI = sum of squared market shares, share = Publisher Global_Sales / total Global_Sales (all years 1980-2020, 578 publishers, rows with missing Publisher dropped).
game_market_hhi.note: Highly unconcentrated market (HHI 0.0793 on 0-1 scale = 792.9 on 0-10000 scale). Filling missing Publisher with 'Unknown' changes value only to 0.07904371.

books.note: average_rating of all 11127 books; median 3.96, range 0-5

movies.note: vote_average over all non-null rows (incl. 2998 zeros). Alternative: restricting to vote_count>0 gives mean 6.0009 median 6.1 (n=42561); vote_count-weighted mean is 6.6815.
